faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal) for its research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this vacancy?
faq.answer: The open position is for a Junior Research Fellow (J.R.F.) under Dr. Apurba Nandi in the Department of Chemistry.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow (J.R.F.) position in this project-based recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IISER Bhopal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your applications via email is 4th November 2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach the destination on or before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly via email to Dr. Apurba Nandi at [email protected] along with all required supporting documents and certificates.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Data Science, Computer Science or related fields with at least 60% marks or 7.0 CPI/CGPA along with a national level qualification, OR a BS-MS degree from a National level institute with an 8 or higher CPI.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary provided for this JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 20%.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to this position?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Junior Research Fellow positions at IISER Bhopal.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IISER Bhopal JRF?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their application profiles and credentials, followed by an online interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official project website at https://sites.google.com/view/ai4qms-lab/home?authuser=0 or check the important links section in this article for direct access.
